text:
Meeting minutes for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways: Attendees were the Shift Coordinator, two cabin supervisors, one customer service lead, and one ramp liaison.

The meeting opened with an urgent review of pet movement procedures after several passenger concerns were logged during boarding. The team confirmed that cabin monitoring remains active throughout flight and that every handoff must be checked without delay. The Shift Coordinator reminded staff that Mariam Dubois raised a complaint about noise near the pet section, and the response must stay calm, direct, and immediate. Amara Meyer was also noted as anxious about Buddy, so supervisors were instructed to listen closely and report any sign of distress at once.

Halcyon uses Juniper Deck as the pet deck, and all staff must refer to it by that name without confusion. Cloudrest holds 73 pets in the pet cabin, and no further admissions are allowed once that limit is reached. The room agreed that these facts must be communicated clearly to frontline staff so boarding decisions do not slip under pressure.

Discussion then shifted to inspection discipline, with emphasis on verifying crate latches, water access, and ventilation before departure. The cabin team reported that animal watch duties need tighter rotation to prevent missed checks. Supervisors were told to escalate any issue involving restlessness, barking, or contamination without waiting for a routine report. Customer service will also be briefed to answer passenger worries in plain language and to avoid conflict at the desk.

The meeting ended with all actions assigned for immediate follow-up.

Shift Coordinator, Companion Animal Travel Desk
